affected_receipt.note: This audit does NOT edit, supersede, or delete the affected receipt (ROTATION-mode fire; supersession is a REPAIR-mode action for an R-prefixed campaign item). The affected receipt's own numeric result (p=0.2554, not significant), its boolean field, its headline, and its verdict code all already agree with each other and are NOT in dispute -- EIS_WITHIN_INSTRUMENT_DISCRIMINATION_NOT_ESTABLISHED is the correct reading of that receipt's own statistics. Only the 'meaning' prose sentence is wrong, and only that sentence should be corrected. Left as-is, any downstream consumer (mission.md prose, a future consolidated-index build, a human skimming only 'meaning') that trusts the explanatory gloss over the raw fields would report the wrong conclusion -- that within-instrument EIS discrimination IS established, when the module's own statistics say it is not.

awaiting: A repair fire (R-prefixed campaign item) to supersede the affected receipt's 'meaning' field and log it in RETRACTION-INDEX.md.
does_not_close: This receipt performs no new coating-physics test and fits no model; it is a structural/textual self-consistency audit of the repo's own signed-receipt tree.
It does not modify, supersede, or delete the affected receipt (eis-reproducibility-discrimination-power-v1) or any other file.

The DOES/does-NOT marker convention is this codebase's own observed house style (confirmed present and used consistently for genuine emphasis elsewhere in this module's receipts); a receipt phrasing the same contradiction without that exact marker would not be caught by this pass.
No manifest, no signed Phase-0 KPI, and no cross-module file was touched.

findings_detail.contradicting_sentence: Partitions the prior 'underpowered' verdict: the EIS instrument's endpoint barrier signal DOES separate the six benchmark systems above its own ISO-5725 measurement-noise floor (parametric hostile-null p below), so the single-instrument benchmark has real within-instrument discrimination validity;

headline: Scanned 11 currently-signed evidence/audit/ receipts in this module with a general (non-hardcoded, non-file-specific) keyword-overlap polarity detector: 1 self-contradiction(s) found in 1 receipt(s). evidence/audit/eis-reproducibility-discrimination-power-v1's own 'interpretation.meaning' field asserts 'the EIS instrument's endpoint barrier signal DOES separate the six benchmark systems above its own ISO-5725 measurement-noise floor ... has real within-instrument discrimination validity' -- the literal opposite of that same receipt's own boolean field interpretation.eis_discriminates_systems_above_noise_floor=false, its discrimination.significant_at_0p05=false (p=0.2554), its headline ('does NOT separate ... above its measurement-noise floor'), and its own verdict code EIS_WITHIN_INSTRUMENT_DISCRIMINATION_NOT_ESTABLISHED. The detector fired on exactly this 1 of 11 scanned receipts -- 0/10 others, confirming specificity rather than a systematically over-eager rule.
hypothesis_H0: No signed evidence/audit/ receipt in amphora-public-corrosion-benchmark contains a boolean field whose value is contradicted by an explicit DOES/does-NOT polarity assertion about the same predicate (>=2 shared stopword-stripped keyword stems) in that receipt's own 'meaning' text.

methodology.detector: for every dict in the decoded payload carrying a string field 'meaning' plus >=1 boolean sibling: split 'meaning' into sentences on [.;]; for each boolean field build a stopword-stripped, 8-char-stemmed keyword set from its own name; any sentence sharing >=min(2,|keywords|) of those stems is 'about' that predicate; if that sentence contains this codebase's own house-style emphasis marker \bDOES\b it is scored polarity=True, if it contains \bdoes NOT\b / \bdoes not\b it is scored polarity=False; a scored polarity that disagrees with the boolean's actual value is a finding.
methodology.determinism: glob.glob() results sorted; no randomness; pure function of on-disk bytes.
methodology.scope: every evidence/audit/*/*.dsse.json signed receipt currently on disk in this module
methodology.signed_receipt_detection: a .dsse.json file counts iff it is a dict with either a top-level 'signature' dict containing a 'payload' key, or top-level 'payload'+'signatures' keys; the base64 payload is decoded and parsed.
methodology.specificity_check: the same unmodified detector was run against all currently-signed evidence/audit/ receipts in the module, not hand-selected to the one receipt already suspected of the defect; per-receipt finding counts are reported below so a follow-up audit can confirm the detector was not systematically biased toward or away from any one file.

purpose: Intra-receipt self-consistency audit: does each signed evidence/audit/ receipt in this module agree with itself -- specifically, does its free-text 'meaning' interpretation ever assert the opposite polarity from a co-located boolean/verdict field about the same predicate? Orthogonal escalation past the three prior REFUTED cross-file staleness findings on this module's audit corpus (kpi-surface-completeness-v1, consolidated-kpi-staleness-v1, consolidated-index-third-recurrence-v1), which all tested whether the consolidated INDEX reflects what's on disk. This never reads the index; it tests whether each on-disk receipt reflects itself.
recommended_repair: A future R-prefixed repair item should supersede eis-reproducibility-discrimination-power-v1's receipt with a corrected 'meaning' sentence (e.g. 'does NOT separate' in place of 'DOES separate'), per the supersede-never-rewrite protocol, and log the correction in RETRACTION-INDEX.md. This audit intentionally does not perform that repair itself (ROTATION mode, no R-/V- campaign item bound to this fire).
